errors.evidence: The tick mark intervals on the x-axis are not regular 5-year steps. The first interval from 1984 to 1990 is a 6-year step, while the subsequent intervals are 5-year steps.
The starting value for Line 1 in 1984 is approximately 27.5%, not 29%.

errors.evidence: Line 3 (open triangles) has a dip around 2008, but the value is approximately 9%, not 11%.
The final data point for Line 3 in 2018 is closer to 12%, not 11%.
Line 6 (solid green) begins at approximately 12% in 1984, not 16%. The description seems to have confused it with Line 2, which starts at 16%.

The description fails to mention the legend, which is crucial for identifying which line corresponds to which category. It only refers to the lines by number (e.g., 'Linie 1').
